win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 8 or more symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

scatters.name: LESTER’S CASH CAROUSEL
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the LESTER’S CASH CAROUSEL bonus feature with 10 free spins. This bonus feature retains the mechanics of the base game, and there is an increased chance of landing high multipliers!

 The bonus feature has a special Bounty Balloon that duplicates all applied multipliers from the total win bar!

 During the bonus all activated multipliers that are added to the Total Win Bar are also stored in a Bounty Balloon outside the grid. The multiplier amount in the Balloon grows until you pop it by landing an Epic Needle Box! Once popped, the multiplier amount stored in the Balloon will be added to the Total Win Bar multipliers and the Balloon will respawn and start collecting multipliers again!

 The multiplier value in the Bounty Balloon in LESTER’S CASH CAROUSEL will reset to 0 at respawn, ready to grow again!

 The bonus game also features Epic Needle Boxes. Landed Epic Needle Boxes clears all low- and high-paying symbols on the grid and pops the Bounty Balloon, instantly combining the effects of both Low- and High-Symbol Needle Boxes and awarding the Bounty Balloon multiplier!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 2 FS symbols award 2 extra spins;

 3 FS symbols award 4 extra spins.

scatters.name: JESTER’S JACKPOT
scatters.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the JESTER’S JACKPOT bonus feature with 10 free spins. This bonus feature retains the mechanics of the LESTER’S CASH CAROUSEL bonus!

 The Bounty Balloon in JESTER’S JACKPOT will respawn with the previous multiplier value intact, ready to grow again!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 2 FS symbols award 2 extra spins;

 3 FS symbols award 4 extra spins.

multipliers.name: KLOWN MULTIPLIERS
multipliers.behavior:
Klown Multiplier symbols activate at the end of each spin if at least one win occurred during that spin.

 Adding Klown Multiplier symbols can land with an initial value of 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, or 500x. The multiplier is added to the current multiplier in the Total Win Bar when it is activated.

 Multiplying Klown Multiplier symbols can land with an initial value of x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, or x20. The multiplier then multiplies the current multiplier in the Total Win Bar when it is activated.

collectors.name: TOTAL WIN BAR
collectors.behavior: All wins are collected in the Total Win Bar outside the grid during each round. Any activated Klown Multipliers are added to the Total Win Bar at the end of a spin in sequence and the result of all multipliers are then applied to the collected win amount.

specials.name: NEEDLE BOXES
specials.behavior:
Landed Needle Box symbols activate once the current grid is settled and all wins have been awarded, and trigger a grid-clear that removes symbols corresponding to the type of the Needle Box.

 Low-Symbol Needle Boxes will remove all low-paying symbols on the grid, awarding 0.1 times the bet per removed symbol.

 High-Symbol Needle Boxes will remove all high-paying symbols on the grid, awarding 0.3 times the bet per removed symbol.
